steps.npc: Ah, it's a secret I'm afraid.

steps.text: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Enlightened Journey quest.

before-enlightened-journey.npc: Greetings! Would you like to be my number one  accomplice? I mean, assistant?
I am Auguste. I am going to be the first balloonist in all of Gielinor!

before-enlightened-journey.player: Balloo-what? I thought only monks lived on Entrana.

before-enlightened-journey.npc: Well, they do... I was a monk. But I'm so sick of living on this island! I want to explore new frontiers!

before-enlightened-journey.player: And go where no man has gone before?

before-enlightened-journey.npc: Maybe! That sounds good. I was thinking just over to Taverley, though.

before-enlightened-journey.player: Why not take the boat then?

before-enlightened-journey.npc: Ugh! Ocean! Don't talk to me about the ocean...oh dear...I feel ill.

before-enlightened-journey.player: Whoa, ok, no ocean. How exactly are you going to get off the island, then?

before-enlightened-journey.npc: I have devised a new way to travel. But I need an assistant balloonist to help me build my design.
Are you an experienced adventurer willing to help me?

steps.player: Wait, I still don't know exactly what we're doing.

steps.npc: Of course, of course, how foolish of me. Well, we are going to make a balloon.

initial-dialogue-after-enlightened-journ.npc: Hello, [player name]. It is good to see you again. My enterprise has grown since we last met. I've expanded all over Gielinor!
If you'd like to go to a new location, you will have to help fly the balloon again. Some of the routes are very dangerous!
But each route you complete will earn you Firemaking experience.
Once you've opened a route, it only costs 1 log of the corresponding type to travel there again, from any location you've already opened!
I have also hired assistants to watch over the balloons at each new location we go to. They will help you get where you want to go.
Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.

options.text: Could you tell me how to make an origami balloon?

steps.player: Could you tell me how to make an origami balloon?

steps.npc: First, use the papyrus on the ball of wool. The papyrus is folded into an origami box and the yarn will support the heat source.
Next, add the unlit candle to the balloon structure. It will act as the heat source.
Now you have an origami balloon!
If you use your origami balloon with any dye, you can change the colour.
You can release the balloon and watch it float in the air, just use a tinderbox on it.

options.text: Could you replace some items for me?
options.condition: If the bomber jacket or cap has been lost

steps.text: If the bomber cap has not been lost:

initial-dialogue-after-enlightened-journ.npc: You still seem to have your cap.

steps.text: If the bomber cap has been lost but there is no free inventory space:

steps.npc: You don't have enough free space for your cap.

steps.text: If the bomber cap has been lost:

steps.npc: Here's your cap. Try to keep better track of it.

steps.text: If the bomber jacket has not been lost:

steps.npc: You don't need a new jacket; you still have your original one.

steps.text: If the bomber jacket has been lost but there is no free inventory space:

steps.npc: You don't have enough free space for your jacket.

steps.text: If the bomber jacket has been lost:

steps.npc: Here's your jacket, to keep you warm during flight.

options.text: Could you combine my cap and goggles?
options.condition: If the player has a bomber cap and gnome goggles

steps.npc: There you go! You look like a true airship pilot now.

steps.text: If the player is wearing them:

steps.npc: I can't combine them if you are wearing them.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have space for the cap and goggles:

steps.npc: You don't have enough free space for the cap and goggles.
